# Tools the build workflow installs, pinned with their hashes: pip refuses a
# file whose hash differs (--require-hashes). Both are pure Python and have no
# dependencies of their own.
#
# To update: raise the version, take the sha256 of the wheel from
# https://pypi.org/project/<name>/<version>/#files and replace the hash.
polib==1.2.0 \
    --hash=sha256:1c77ee1b81feb31df9bca258cbc58db1bbb32d10214b173882452c73af06d62d
pyflakes==3.4.0 \
    --hash=sha256:f742a7dbd0d9cb9ea41e9a24a918996e8170c799fa528688d40dd582c8265f4f
